name: Sequences to remember
description: Watch a sequence of squares (or digits) and repeat it in the same order or backwards. Trains working memory; the length adapts automatically.
instructions:
Some squares will light up one after another. Watch carefully.
Then tap the squares in the same order.
If it goes well, the next sequence will be a little longer.
instructionsKids:
The little stars light up one after another! ⭐
Watch carefully, then tap the squares in the same order.
repeat: Now repeat in the same order
repeatBackward: Now repeat BACKWARDS (from last to first)
wrong: Not quite, let's try the next one
